question: What are the top 5 items with the highest year-over-year growth percentage in total sales revenue for the year 2023?
sql:
WITH yearly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS yr,
    SUM(sale_dollars) AS total_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
    AND bottles_sold > 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
)
SELECT 
  item_number,
  item_description,
  SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2022,
  SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2023 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2023 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 100 AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM yearly_sales
GROUP BY item_number, item_description
HAVING revenue_2022 > 0
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT 5
